acceptanceCriteria: Archive delivery uses a single validated full Outcome body for normal and JSON output.
A supported host adapter invokes an actual message-send boundary and reports per-message receipts; capability flags alone never imply accepted or displayed.
Interrupted delivery resumes only from identity-bound contiguous accepted receipts and never reruns archive or verification.
Return-only hosts explicitly report full_handoff_only and unknown host acceptance/display.
Controlled end-to-end adapter tests inspect emitted assistant-message events, consecutive Work Items, long segmented bodies, interruption recovery, and zero-send completion rejection.
The capability boundary and the actual host adapter evidence are documented in the three supported presentation languages without claiming unavailable Codex or Claude APIs.
Legacy lifecycle fields remain available only as a compatibility projection captured inside the same guarded Outcome observation.
A timeout remains a bounded cancellation with no normal exit code even when the terminated shell reports code 0 under Rust 1.98.1.
goal: After every archive, the same validated full Outcome can be delivered through a real host adapter or honestly remain an explicit return-only handoff; retries reuse identity-bound progress and never rerun archive or verification.
intent: Make archived Work Item Outcomes reach a supported Agent message path without losing the complete body
outOfScope: provider credentials or global host configuration

scenarioCoverage.expected: production handoff reports only per-message host acceptance/display evidence; capability declaration alone never produces display_confirmed
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the adapter contract with accepted, unconfirmed, interrupted, duplicate-risk, and zero-send progress records and inspect assistant-message events and delivery state.

scenarioCoverage.expected: when no host send API is available, the returned full body is explicit full_handoff_only and no assistant display claim is made
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run CLI and MCP archive delivery through the return-only adapter and compare the structured delivery state, body digest, and host confirmation fields.
